text: Assumption: Dcm_ResponseDataArrayType is used as a data buffer for response data in operations of the RequestFileTransfer interface — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Dcm_ResponseDataArrayType is used as a data buffer for response data in operations of the RequestFileTransfer interface — is this correct?
norm: dcm_responsedataarraytype is used as a data buffer for response data in operations of the requestfiletransfer interface
assumption: Dcm_ResponseDataArrayType is used as a data buffer for response data in operations of the RequestFileTransfer interface.
rationale: The type shares the exact same variation condition DcmRequestFileTransferUsePort == TRUE as the service RequestFileTransfer and is sized as an array whose dimension is derived from the Tx buffer of the DSL.
